[[File:Badlands_of_Badlands_of_N-g-zi.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The Badlands of N'g'zi]]

The '''Badlands of N'g'zi''' was a vast plain on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], lying in between [[E'Y-Akh Desert/Legends|E'Y-Akh Desert]] and [[N'ge'u Valley]].

In the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]], [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] skirted around the plain to the hangar where his ship was docked, with [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] in close pursuit.
